cases.requirement: Reject zero owner, minter, and royalty recipient; empty name/symbol; zero supply; and royalty above 10000 bps.
Deploy two unrelated collections and prove independent name, symbol, supply, royalty, owner, minter, and recipient values.
Scan ABI and exercise roles to prove no supply, royalty, recipient, minter, title, URI, or hash mutation path exists.
Reject zero, over-supply, duplicate, empty-field, and zero-hash single mints with specific errors.
Prove manual closure and automatic closure at arbitrary maximum supply are irreversible, including sparse token IDs.
Accept batches 1 through 10 and reject empty or 11-item batches.
Prove duplicate IDs and a failure at every later item revert the whole batch, storage, counters, and events.
Prove ordered WorkMinted events and exactly one MintingClosed event when a batch reaches capacity.
Measure worst-case ten-item gas and test validator callback/reentrancy assumptions.
Separate deployer, owner, minter, recipient, and holder; prove only minter mints and only owner changes validator.
Prove renunciation always reverts and ownership can transfer only through inherited non-zero-owner semantics, including a Safe-like owner.
Assert ERC-2981 recipient and arithmetic at 0, typical, and 10000 bps and disclose non-enforcement on direct transfers.
Assert ERC-721, metadata, ERC-2981, ICreatorToken, and legacy interface IDs and reject 0xffffffff.
Snapshot constructor, mintWork selector, batch tuple ABI, events, errors, and public getters for versioned deployment clients.
Install a malicious validator and prove it can block but cannot transfer a holder token without holder approval; automatic validator approval remains absent.
Run allow/block transfers against pinned real Limit Break v5 source and verify list ownership and ruleset 255/options 6.
Exercise EOA, Safe-like contract, and EIP-7702 direct transfers and authorized marketplace paths.
Test authorized SignedZone and rogue authorizer paths without Payment Processor or validator operator approval.
Verify live validator/ruleset/authorizer bytecode and complete disposable OpenSea sale, royalty settlement, and direct-transfer rehearsal.
Obtain independent review of generic constructor, batch path, compiled bytecode, and all corrective evidence before production.
